description: This file defines a Spring component that listens for authentication failure events due to bad credentials and handles incrementing failed login attempts, optionally locking the user if maximum attempts are exceeded.

classes.name: AuthenticationBadCredentialsListener
classes.description: A listener for handling login failures due to bad credentials, increasing failed attempt count, and locking user if limit exceeded.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles the event triggered on authentication failure due to bad credentials, updating user failed attempts and locking account if necessary.
